## Reading the result

Each questioned purchase satisfies the customer's policy **in full** — amount,
merchant, category, product anchor, add-ons, both platform statuses. They are
repeat performances of a job the customer described once.

No existing mechanism sees them. The near-duplicate check is a 60-minute window on
an identical basket; AU0035 and AU0040 are three days apart, same merchant, same
item, both at legitimate prices.

**Zero false positives** on the two mandates that are legitimately repeatable:
`order our household groceries` (recurring) and `the agent may buy clothing`
(standing) are both silent, and both were classified from the customer's own
words with the evidence shown above.

## What it does not show

Nothing about outcomes in the world. The wallet observes what it authorized, never
what was delivered, returned or refunded. A refunded first purchase still counts as
a fulfilment, so the customer is asked again — the safe direction, but a real
limitation. See `FULFILMENT_SECURITY_RESEARCH.md` §10.
